title: An explicit odd-order p-group with as many automorphisms as elements
claim: The explicitly specified BCH group at p=1009, depth 1689, has |G|=|Aut(G)|=1009^52359.
strongest_verified_result: The full finite Lie-ring automorphism order is 1009^(30*i+1689) for every i>=7; at i=1689 the class bound 846<1009 permits Lazard transfer and exact equality with group order.
remaining_mathematical_gap: None identified in the reviewed manuscript and certificate; not a formally verified proof.
limits: No group Cayley table or full automorphism enumeration.
